data.one_liner: A design system providing reusable UI components for Flutter mobile and web.
data.what_it_does: Optimus supplies a collection of styled widgets, design tokens, and layout helpers that can be dropped into a Flutter app. It focuses on mobile first but includes web support. The package ships with a storybook for visual reference.
use_when: You need a consistent, branded UI across a Flutter app
You want to prototype quickly with pre‑styled components
You prefer a single source of truth for colors, typography, and spacing
avoid_when: You only need a few custom widgets and want to avoid a large dependency
You target only web or only iOS/Android and need platform‑specific widgets
weaknesses: Limited to Flutter (no native iOS/Android SDKs)
data.setup_notes: Add to pubspec, import package, no build_runner needed

alternatives.name: material_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides Material Design widgets with theming support

alternatives.name: cupertino_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers Cupertino styled widgets for iOS look and feel
